subject: NovaCorp expansion: provisioning additional app teams + term path
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@novacorp.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion request — add 3 product teams + pricing for term change

Hi Karthik / Ben,

Thanks again for the support on our pilot. We’re ready to push into production and want to bring three additional product teams online over the next 8 weeks. High level asks: 
- Provision separate API keys/namespaces for each new team (sand/stage/prod)
- Updated committed capacity (approx. +45% peak token volume) and how that impacts unit pricing
- A short rollout plan and SOW we can share with procurement (they need an estimated go-live date for each team)

Can you share a commercial path (term amendment vs. new contract) and an initial timeline? Procurement contact is cc’d — they’ll need the legal/billing doc.

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Head of AI Products, NovaCorp
[Attachment: example-internal-architecture.png (PNG)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@novacorp.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — add 3 product teams + pricing for term change

Samantha — great to hear NovaCorp is expanding. Short answer: we can do this as a 12-month amendment to your existing agreement, which keeps the account consolidated and preserves the tenant-level governance you already use.

Next steps I propose:
1) Commercial sketch (this email) — committed throughput tiers + indicative unit pricing (see below).
2) Draft SOW & key map for procurement (attached).
3) CS-run rollout plan with staging windows and security checklist.
4) Legal prepares amendment for signature (DocuSign link once ready).

Indicative commercial (subject to final usage profile):
- Current committed throughput: baseline X tokens/min
- Proposed committed throughput: baseline +45% (applies to billing band B -> C)
- Unit price: +8% on per-token list rate for the new committed band OR keep current unit price if you move to a 24-month term.
- Volume discount: additional 10% off unit price when monthly usage > 1.5x committed for 2 consecutive months.

I’ve attached a SOW draft and a key/name mapping template — Monica, can you confirm the keying approach below and an initial timeline?

Attachments: [NovaCorp_SOW_draft_v2.pdf], [API_key_map_novacorp.csv]

— Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@novacorp.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 10:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — add 3 product teams + pricing for term change

Hi Samantha — looping in CS details. Below is a pragmatic rollout & keying plan we’ve used successfully.

Technical rollout (proposed):
- Week 0–1: Provision namespaces and create 3 x (sand, stage, prod) key sets per team -> 9 key sets; we typically issue 6 keys per team for environment separation and CI usage (total ~18 keys).
- Week 2–4: Integration + smoke tests (KV caching enabled for stage), rate limits staged to 50% of prod target.
- Week 5–8: Gradual traffic ramp to prod; monitoring hooks + quality regression tests.

Key governance notes:
- Recommend separate key prefixes per product team to enable per-key quota metrics in Console.
- We can pin model versions per key to avoid regressions during rollout.
- For higher concurrency, enable prefetch batching and prefix KV caching — this will reduce per-token cost during ramp.

I’ll prepare the rollout_timeline file with specific dates once you confirm go-live windows. For SSO & KMS access, please share the service account emails we should whitelist.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rollout_timeline_novacorp.xlsx]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@novacorp.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 20 Aug 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — add 3 product teams + pricing for term change

Samantha — commercial follow-up. I reviewed internal margin sensitivity and we can offer the following: 

Commercial proposal (finalizable with usage data):
- Keep the amendment to the existing 12-month term; add a committed throughput increase as Karthik sketched (+45%).
- Unit price: list rate +6% for the expanded committed band if you sign the amendment by end of month.
- Additional volume discount: 20% off list unit price for incremental usage above 2x committed, applied as a rebate once threshold hit for two months.
- If procurement prefers a 24-month extension, we can lock current list unit price with a small implementation credit (one-time).

Laura — can you drive billing/contract items and prep the amendment? Procurement (cc) — happy to queue the DocuSign once legal approves.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@novacorp.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — add 3 product teams + pricing for term change

Thanks — this looks good and addresses procurement’s questions. A couple quick asks before we proceed: 
1) Can you send the finalized SOW + amendment by EOD Thursday so procurement can review?
2) We’ll aim for an initial go-live for Team A on Sept 10; Teams B/C to follow in three-week increments.
3) Procurement prefers DocuSign for the amendment; contact there is procurement@novacorp.com.

Please include the key_map CSV in the DocuSign packet or provide a secure Drive link. Once procurement signs, we’ll provide the service accounts to whitelist.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — happy to hop on a 30m call if helpful.

Best,
Samantha
Head of AI Products, NovaCorp
